source.title: Pricing - Claude API Docs (section 'Model pricing', footnote 2, 'Prompt caching', 'Long context pricing', 'Fast mode pricing', 'Data residency pricing', 'Web search tool')
source.method: WebFetch of the official Anthropic docs pricing page during the run (not remembered prices)

notes: Row 'Claude Opus 5.5': $4 / MTok base input, $5 / MTok 5m cache writes, $8 / MTok 1h cache writes, $0.20 / MTok cache hits and refreshes, $20 / MTok output.
Footnote 2: cache hits and refreshes on Claude Opus 5.5 are priced at 0.05x the base input price (4 x 0.05 = 0.20).
Cache write multipliers: 5-minute write 1.25x base input (4 x 1.25 = 5), 1-hour write 2x base input (4 x 2 = 8).
Output tokens include extended-thinking tokens (billed as output).

long_context.note: Long context pricing: 'Claude 4.6 and later models (except Claude Haiku 5.5) ... include the full 1M token context window at standard pricing.' No surcharge tier for Opus 5.5.

fast_mode.note: Fast mode table: Claude Opus 5.5 $8 input / $40 output per MTok; 'Prompt caching multipliers apply on top of fast mode pricing' (1.25x, 2x, 0.05x of $8). Applied only to messages whose usage.speed == 'fast'.

batch.note: Batch API 50 % discount; not applicable to interactive Claude Code sessions.

modifiers.inference_geo_note: Data residency pricing: inference_geo 'us' applies 1.1x to all token categories on Claude 4.6 and later models; 'global' (default) uses standard pricing. Applied only to messages whose usage.inference_geo == 'us'.
modifiers.web_search_note: Web search tool: $10 per 1,000 searches plus standard token costs. Counted from usage.server_tool_use.web_search_requests.
modifiers.web_fetch_note: Web fetch tool: no additional charge beyond standard token costs.
